description: Severe Wind Hazard Assessment for Western Australia: Data Collection – ArcGIS Full Suite and Map Package is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. This dataset contains a collection of ESRI geodatabases that hold hazard and impact data derived as part of the Severe Wind Hazard Assessment for Western Australia (2017-2020) project. There are separate geodatabases for each community examined in the project. Within each community, multiple TC scenarios were analysed for each community. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are EARTH SCIENCES, Meteorology, Natural Hazards, Published_External, Severe Wind Hazard Assessment for Western Australia - SWHAWA. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
